description: Source code for a firmware header generator tool, including functions for CRC calculation, header construction, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board info structure by its ID string.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line tool.

methods.name: writel
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value into a buffer at a specified offset in network byte order.

methods.name: crc32_csum
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a buffer and writes it into the buffer.

methods.name: meraki_build_hdr
methods.description: Builds a firmware header with checksum and writes it to output file.
